An '''Ithorian bartender''' was the owner of the [[Mos Espa Podracer Cantina]]. He served drinks to whoever came by, especially a lone [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]]. His cantina was actually only open to [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and mechanics and only in the weeks leading up to the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] race in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], which was won by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. His cantina was relatively small but boasted a large [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] that was exclusively stored with facts about [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] bartender first appeared in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' during transitions from the main menu and the racer select area and is tapping his hands on the counter. The cantina patrons varied between game characters and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. However, there was always a lone Jawa that appeared consistently in the bar.
